title: George Wasn't Invited To The Choe Show

segments.x: I went to the Cho Show. Oh, so Kalilah went to the Cho Show. Yeah, I didn't get invited. Did you apply for it? Yes! Did you try, though? Like, did you put actual good...
Yeah, I tried. The Cho Show is a month-long art show by our friend David Choe. If you guys aren't familiar, go check him out. But I cried. I know. Everybody I hear has...

Everybody who's gone had a religious experience. But everyone has a different experience, though. I never went. Yeah, Bobby didn't go. Did you get invited? Yes, you did. I don't remember, but I'm going to say this right now.

I'm not signing up. I'm not making an appointment for no fucking art show. Are you above it? No, it's not that I'm above it. Just tell me where it is. Yeah. You know how the art show goes, the exhibition's open from May 1st to May 20th.

You can come anytime. Oh, at the gallery. That's what art is supposed to be. Not this one. I know. Well, this one I didn't go to because I didn't have the time. This is a more controlled setting, and I think that it makes perfect sense that people had to basically sign up and get screened.
It makes sense. Once you go through it, you're like, oh. Well, tell us what happens. I can't. Why? No way. I don't want to ruin it for people who are still about to go.
No one's going to watch it. No, I'm not going to do it. There's only 20 artsy-fartsy, what, Rainn Wilson. He's not listening. Rainn Wilson. Yeah, Rainn Wilson. Who else? The guy from Creed.

Creed's there? I don't know, but I'm just throwing out names now. Just naming people? Yeah, naming people. You're also not. You sign an NDA, basically, so you're not allowed to. Why do you need to bring it on?
No, because I wanted to. I can talk about how I felt. How did you feel about it? I don't understand how you cried. I'm curious about that. Well, I'm very easy to make cry.

Steven also cried, too. Everybody I talked to who went to it cried, and it was a super experience for him. I think you go into it already feeling overwhelmed because you don't know what you're about to face.
And a lot of that built up because I'm sort of a control freak in that way because I want to know what I'm getting myself into. So a lot of the feeling, I'm already tense and I'm already nervous.

So I think I probably cried partially because I was nervous and partially submitting to the experience, which was actually kind of nice. It was very cathartic and I appreciated it. And I think you should do it.
Well, it's too late now, right? It's not. I think he has one more week. Well, can you set it up? I've been trying to set it up for you.
